endorsements.quote: Patient-consumers are empowered through measures in education to understand personal digital twins in the best possible way and to be able to use them in accordance with their values and interests.
Authorization procedures, certification, and regulation of digital twin services, and information requirements for providers of such services are defined and agile.

unlisted_practices: Ensure patient-consumers decide on the generation, data sources, design, type of use, and lifetime of their personal digital twin services.
Continue to enable care for individuals who do not want to use digital twin services, and do not make digital twin use mandatory.
Integrate digital twin services into interprofessional treatment teams where the necessary competencies are available and responsibilities are clarified.
Have the state establish benchmarks for the quality and security of digital twin services.
Have the state provide a data infrastructure through which patient-consumers can bring together data sources from all areas of life.
Bill medical services to reimburse recommendations of high-quality and appropriately certified digital twin services.
Foster clinician competence in using digital twin technology in medical curricula.
Make health data of greatest public health importance available in anonymized form to third parties through the state data infrastructure.
Ensure digital twin service infrastructure works internationally to allow location-independent use.
Apply fine-tuned data access levels and documented access histories to guard against undue influence and abuse of patient data.
Ensure patients can opt out of nudging or recommendations from digital twins without financial or social detriment.
